children: Hill, who was appointed to board of Forterra in June, purchased the shares at an average price of 138.30p each, for a total value of £40,029.55.
As of 1430 BST, Forterra shares were up 1.46% at 138.80p.
Reporting by Iain Gilbert at Sharecast.com
